basis: Governance: the March 2022 Shqiptarja article calls the Ministry of Culture the superior institution of the gallery and says directors of its institutions are chosen by decision of the Council of Ministers. Red tape: the same article, quotes from the ministry's chief of cabinet.
Governance: the About text on the home page says TAL was founded as a non-profit organization on the initiative of Adela Demetja in 2010.

Governance: Presidential Decree 79/11 of 19 April 2011 recites that the foundation was constituted by public deed before a Luanda notary on 7 May 2006 and declares it of public utility.
